tags.description: Portage to Wildcat Lake - this 660m portage leaves the river bank just above P13 connecting the Sand River Route to the Old Woman Lake - Gamitagama Lake Route (see Old Woman Lake to Sand River, and Gamitagama Lake to Old Woman Lake map).
tags.name: P13

tags.description: P17 Calwin Falls is only one of two significant drops in the Sand River. This is a rough and rocky portage.
tags.name: P17

tags.description: P23 - Lady Evelyn Falls is the second significant drop in the Sand River. This is the longest and most treacherous portage on the route. Do not put in at the "middle campsite" as there is a stretch of rapids still to be avoided.
tags.name: P23
Lake Superior Coastal Trail
tags.note: The Lake Superior Coastal Trail is apart of the Trans-Canada Trail (hiking section)

tags.name: Bridget Lake Trail
tags.note: Hiking trail segment not listed on Ontario Parks website. Old road is also outside any park boundaries. Hiking trail is mentioned on Naturally Superior Adventures but provides no map. No signage limits road access to foot traffic.
